identifiers: Original official four-digit party codes and two-digit constituency codes; labels use official abbreviation when available.

zero_completion.proof: All explicit current counts are nonnegative integers; each local list exhausts its official valid-vote subtotal; each national party count equals the sum of listed constituency counts. Hence omitted local cells have zero votes.
zero_completion.seat_proof: All threshold-eligible parties have explicit current national and all constituency split oracles. Omitted parties are below the 4% national and 12% every-constituency thresholds and therefore receive zero seats.

oracle.fixed_leveling_split: current explicit antalFastaMandat and antalUtjamningsmandat, not allocator output

coverage.polling_districts: source ZIP present; vote rows not normalized in this slice

comparison_fields: ForegaendeVal and forandring fields are never used as current observations.
source_authentication: All pinned source SHA-256 checks, official index MD5 and three JSON signatures passed before normalization; key from official HTTPS certificate.
